title: Template:Book
wikitext:
Formats text in the style of a book. ; Syntax : {{syntax|Book|params={{param|book title}}{{param|width|number + unit}}{{param|height|number + unit}}{{param|float|string}}{{param|clear|string}}{{param|align|string}}{{param|content|any}}}} Parameters: ;1=:Title of the book. ;width=:Width of container where the value is a number with unit of measurement. (Defaults to a max width of 44em, optimal line length + margins) ;height=:Max height of contents where the value is a number with unit of measurement. Also applies overflow-y: auto;. ;float=:Float direction ["left"/"right"]. ;clear=:Clear direction ["both"/"left"/"right"]. ;align=:Text alignment for the book's content.
